intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for TelemetryMeters. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Single owner of the Micrometer meter names and bounded tags of the context (tags are enumerations only, NEVER deviceId): counters telemetry.packets.received{source_kind}, telemetry.samples.validated{metric,status}, telemetry.samples.reordered{metric}, telemetry.revisions.appended{reason}; timer telemetry.pipeline.latency{stage in validate,history}. Consumers pin this unit and never spell meter names. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration (no stereotype annotation). Metrics are asserted through an injected SimpleMeterRegistry.

methods.semantics: Increments counter telemetry.packets.received with tag source_kind=sourceKind name.
Increments counter telemetry.samples.validated with tags metric and status.
Increments counter telemetry.samples.reordered with tag metric.
Increments counter telemetry.revisions.appended with tag reason.
Records timer telemetry.pipeline.latency with tag stage; stage must be one of validate, history (IllegalArgumentException otherwise).
